name: llm-eval-harness
description: Offline evaluation suite (promptfoo) for a small RAG and tool-calling support assistant over a fictional neobank corpus
author: Brad Hetherington

scripts.eval:smoke: promptfoo eval --env-file .env -c promptfooconfig.yaml --filter-metadata tier=smoke --max-concurrency 4 -o results/smoke.json -o results/smoke.html
scripts.eval:validate: promptfoo validate -c promptfooconfig.yaml && promptfoo validate -c promptfooconfig.retrieval.yaml && promptfoo validate -c promptfooconfig.calibration.yaml
